title: Realtime sessions opened with the OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1 header stopped connecting in May 2026
symptoms: Voice agent built on the Realtime beta fails to open a session
cause: The Realtime API beta interface, selected with the OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1 header, shut down on 2026-05-12, and the gpt-4o realtime and audio preview models were retired on 2026-05-07.
fix: Remove the beta header, move to a GA realtime model, and retest every client event your code sends and handles against the GA reference.
affected: OpenAI Realtime API beta, shut down 2026-05-12; preview realtime and audio models retired 2026-05-07
